headline: Waist-high SSE windswell with a glassy morning — log it early or skip it.
today: Small short-period slop on tap, but the dawn and morning winds are light NNW then W, so it'll be clean and rideable before the S onshore fills in around midday. Get your session in early on the pushing tide off the 6:10a low. Log or groveler, nothing more.

daysToWatch.note: Prime ESE angle finally shows with longer-period sets and a glassy light dawn, but it's only knee-to-waist. Worth a dawn log if you're local, not much else.
